## Activity

During April 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 52 captures. This report summarises the activity completed during the month and the subsequent grading outcomes. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance at the site. No additional activity is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 52 captures, 3 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.8. The result identifies a small proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered in the site’s routine operational review. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate process.

## Grading

A total of 11 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 19. These figures should be read alongside the activity and image quality information above when reviewing the service provided by Oakridge Primary Care during April 2022. This report records the submitted captures, the ungradable outcomes and the referable grading results for the month.
